summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid-interconnection power-equipment node. The reference lane is represented by Eaton as the obvious large-cap electrical-equipment leader with direct data-center order momentum and switchgear capacity additions. The underfollowed lane prioritizes public companies closer to project execution, engineered electrical systems, and site/electrical infrastructure: Powell Industries, IES Holdings, and Sterling Infrastructure.
